confirmedIssues.rule: MDC-026 / MDC-033: unavailable statistical evidence must remain distinguishable from a supported neutral result.
confirmedIssues.mechanism: When both sample SDs are zero, welchTTest returns null at line 195 and pooled Cohen d is null at line 333. With >=5 observations per side the insufficient-sample branch is bypassed, but verdict starts as noChange and changes only inside the nonnull significance/effect-size gate. Thus an uncomputable test is returned as noChange, despite a large observed mean difference.
relatedEvidence: firmwareImpact.ts:241 rounds sample SD to one decimal, so the same branch can also be reached by sufficiently small nonzero variance.
firmwareImpact.ts:297-316 guards only sample size; :335-342 defaults to noChange; :356-360 preserves null test values alongside that verdict.
FirmwareImpactDetails.tsx:20,70-72 uses No measurable change as the noChange fallback; :105-108 displays an em dash for unavailable p/d.
FirmwareImpactPage.tsx:59 admits every verdict except insufficient to the chart/export.
Existing firmwareImpact.test.ts:106-129 and :191-211 use nonzero variance for identical/neutral samples. Test bodies were read, not executed.

sourceDerivedRepro.fixture: Synthetic only: one installed version at 2026-06-15T00:00:00Z; five drives on June 8-12 with distanceM=10000 and energyUsedWh=2000; five drives on June 16-20 with distanceM=10000 and energyUsedWh=3000. Distinct synthetic IDs and otherwise valid typed fields.
sourceDerivedRepro.walkthrough: Each side clears minSample=5 and lies within the nominal window. Samples have means 200 and 300 Wh/km and SDs 0. Welch denominator is 0, therefore p/t/df are null; pooled SD is 0, therefore d is null. The returned verdict remains noChange, deltaWhPerKm=100, deltaShare=0.5, significantCount=0.
sourceDerivedRepro.actualSourceOutcome: Per-version evidence labels the comparison No measurable change while showing +100 Wh/km (+50%) and unavailable p/d. The version is included in the neutral chart/export rather than distinguished as statistically unassessable.
sourceDerivedRepro.expected: Retain observed means, sample sizes and signed delta, but explicitly distinguish unavailable/degenerate statistical assessment from a completed neutral verdict. Do not infer causal significance or fabricate p/d.
